verdict.rationale: Vast Serverless is a first-party product for running GPU workloads without managing GPUs, billed for execution rather than rental time. It has benchmark-driven automatic scaling that recruits GPUs to fit the workload, and endpoints can be deployed through a Python SDK, the CLI, or the agent skill. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scale-to-zero behavior (only implied by execution-based billing), detail on autoscaling configuration and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of serverless deployments.
